def transform(grid):

    seen = set()
    objects = []

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]

            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []

                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))

            min_r = min(y for y, x in cells)
            max_r = max(y for y, x in cells)
            min_c = min(x for y, x in cells)
            max_c = max(x for y, x in cells)

            objects.append((color, obj))

    objects = []

        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]

                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))

                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))

            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
            objects.append((sum(y for y, x in cells) / len(cells),
